message:
- Added Trial Dungeons with new battles and rewards.
- Added leaderboards so you can compete with other players.
- Improved the Upgrade Shop and Challenge screens.
- Fixed a rare bug that could cause problems with ads.
- Added a close button to the Daily Login screen.
- Loot chests now drop less often for better game balance.
- Offline rewards now appear after being away a little longer.
- Improved the game’s systems behind the scenes.
